name: MuslimInk

changelog_id: Rombak Total Card Shalat Berikutnya Bergaya Apple Design Language: Tampilan baru ala Live Activity / Dynamic Island dengan pill badge hitam inversi, timer pill waktu tersisa, kartu jam inset squircle bersudut halus, subjudul klasifikasi shalat & rakaat, serta capsule progress bar modern
Peningkatan Responsivitas & Efisiensi Memori: Optimasi rendering ikon kubah masjid modern dan deduplikasi tabel langkah instalasi sehingga ukuran berkas tetap hemat dan stabil di memori X4 Pro
changelog_en: Next Prayer Hero Card Overhaul to Apple Design Language: Sleek Apple HIG Live Activity / Dynamic Island styling with inverted capsule badge, live countdown pill, inset squircle time card, prayer classification subhead, and rounded capsule playback progress bar
Enhanced Responsiveness & Memory Footprint: Streamlined modern mosque dome vector icon rendering and installation steps deduplication for ultra-compact runtime performance on X4 Pro
